name: Syzygy
author: Erin Carter
description: Three quicksilver pools in a strict 3:2:1 radius grading hang far apart across a wide, slowly shearing triangle. Built as a summed 2D metaball field iso-surfaced through smooth-min, bodies bulge toward each other, neck, snap into a lopsided peanut, then pinch reluctantly back to distance. Once per grand cycle all three thread into a single elongated body — the full syzygy — before pinching back to three. Each pool owns one palette colour in its rim; fusions blend the hue and flash colour 3.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: Overall scale of the three pools' triangle in css pixels; the high default keeps the resting state reading as a spread constellation.

params.label: Tempo
params.effect: How fast the pairwise cycles run and how often the full syzygy comes around.

params.label: Rim width
params.effect: Thickness of the bright rim highlight in css pixels, from hairline mirror edge to soft halo.

params.label: Flash strength
params.effect: Brightness of the colour-3 snap at every fusion and pinch; at zero alignments pass without fanfare.
